question: In which of the following years was the OffSide rule abolished in field hockey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1996.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** International Hockey Federation Rule Board** has repealed the **offside rule in field hockey.**
 
• The** positioning of players **from the** offensive team** was previously controlled by **offside rules,** which were akin to the **offside rule in soccer.**
 
• The** field hockey** rules changed along with the **offside regulations.**
 
• The goals of this modification were to
 
 
• **shift the balance of power** toward the offensive,
 
• increase the** area around the circle** and in the middle of the field,
 
• **aid in the flow **of play,
 
• **increase goals **and decrease whistles,
 
• and improve the **appeal of the game to spectators.** 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
